evals.prompt: Organize an article claiming tea doubles productivity for everyone without citing research. Comment A reports feeling more focused (900 likes); B reports no effect (30 likes).
evals.expected_output: Separate opinion, feeling, experience, and unsupported causation; popularity is not consensus.

evals.prompt: Use only this abstract: an observational study of 100 people found tea associated with self-reported focus, p=0.04. Full text unavailable.
evals.expected_output: State abstract-only scope, distinguish association from causation, flag missing effect size and methods without inventing source limitations.

evals.prompt: Write short notes from the material above without browsing.
evals.expected_output: Proceed within settled scope and state lack of independent verification without re-asking.

evals.prompt: Organize that paper. No file, URL, title, or text is available.
evals.expected_output: Ask one question to identify or obtain the source; do not invent a summary.
